Now, it's also available for iPhone.


How it works:

1) The first time the app is launched, a specific phone number can be selected.

2) After that, you can do one-click calls from your home screen to the selected number.

3) If you want to change the phone number, you have to switch on the edit toggle in Preferences -> Red Phone.
